package main

// The byte-level corpus: a portable document is judged from its TEXT, as Go's json.Unmarshal into Portable and VerifyPortable judge it, so
// what a parsed tree cannot say is covered - number literals (65.0, 1e0, 2^64), duplicate keys (a wrongly typed one before a good one, a null
// after a value), keys in another case or in a Unicode fold (U+017F, the Kelvin sign), a hex string with a trailing newline or a prefix, a
// number written as a string, invalid UTF-8 and lone surrogates in strings, whitespace, trailing data. Each case is a list of byte edits of a
// base file; the verdict is the validator's own (judge, as the mutation corpus uses it).

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

type ByteEdit struct {
	At  int    `json:"at"`
	Del int    `json:"del,omitempty"`
	Ins string `json:"ins,omitempty"` // base64 of the bytes written in place of the deleted ones
}

type ByteCase struct {
	ID     string     `json:"id"`
	Base   int        `json:"base"`
	Op     string     `json:"op"`
	Edits  []ByteEdit `json:"edits"`
	Expect Expect     `json:"expect"`
}

type ByteFile struct {
	Format      string     `json:"format"`
	Description string     `json:"description"`
	Bases       []string   `json:"bases"`
	BaseExpect  []Expect   `json:"baseExpect"`
	Cases       []ByteCase `json:"cases"`
	Skipped     struct {
		Panics int `json:"panics"`
		Flaky  int `json:"flaky"`
	} `json:"skipped"`
}

func ins(s string) string { return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(s)) }

func applyEdits(b []byte, edits []ByteEdit) []byte {
	es := append([]ByteEdit(nil), edits...)
	sort.Slice(es, func(i, j int) bool { return es[i].At > es[j].At })
	out := append([]byte(nil), b...)
	for _, e := range es {
		raw, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(e.Ins)
		out = append(append(append([]byte(nil), out[:e.At]...), raw...), out[e.At+e.Del:]...)
	}
	return out
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// a scanner over the text of a JSON document

type tok struct {
	kind byte // 'n' number, 'v' string value, 'k' key, 'l' true/false/null, '{' '[' open
	s, e int
}

func scanTokens(b []byte) []tok {
	var out []tok
	for i := 0; i < len(b); {
		c := b[i]
		switch {
		case c == '"':
			j := i + 1
			for j < len(b) && b[j] != '"' {
				if b[j] == '\\' {
					j++
				}
				j++
			}
			j++
			k := j
			for k < len(b) && (b[k] == ' ' || b[k] == '\n' || b[k] == '\t' || b[k] == '\r') {
				k++
			}
			kind := byte('v')
			if k < len(b) && b[k] == ':' {
				kind = 'k'
			}
			out = append(out, tok{kind, i, j})
			i = j
		case c == '-' || (c >= '0' && c <= '9'):
			j := i + 1
			for j < len(b) && (b[j] == '.' || b[j] == 'e' || b[j] == 'E' || b[j] == '+' || b[j] == '-' || (b[j] >= '0' && b[j] <= '9')) {
				j++
			}
			out = append(out, tok{'n', i, j})
			i = j
		case c == 't' || c == 'f' || c == 'n':
			j := i
			for j < len(b) && b[j] >= 'a' && b[j] <= 'z' {
				j++
			}
			out = append(out, tok{'l', i, j})
			i = j
		case c == '{' || c == '[':
			out = append(out, tok{c, i, i + 1})
			i++
		default:
			i++
		}
	}
	return out
}

// valueEnd is the end of the JSON value that starts at i.
func valueEnd(b []byte, i int) int {
	for i < len(b) && (b[i] == ' ' || b[i] == '\n' || b[i] == '\t' || b[i] == '\r') {
		i++
	}
	if i >= len(b) {
		return i
	}
	switch b[i] {
	case '"':
		j := i + 1
		for j < len(b) && b[j] != '"' {
			if b[j] == '\\' {
				j++
			}
			j++
		}
		return j + 1
	case '{', '[':
		depth := 0
		for j := i; j < len(b); j++ {
			switch b[j] {
			case '"':
				j++
				for j < len(b) && b[j] != '"' {
					if b[j] == '\\' {
						j++
					}
					j++
				}
			case '{', '[':
				depth++
			case '}', ']':
				depth--
				if depth == 0 {
					return j + 1
				}
			}
		}
		return len(b)
	default:
		j := i
		for j < len(b) && b[j] != ',' && b[j] != '}' && b[j] != ']' && b[j] != ' ' && b[j] != '\n' {
			j++
		}
		return j
	}
}

type member struct {
	ks, ke int // the key token, quotes included
	vs, ve int // the value
}

func members(b []byte, toks []tok) []member {
	var out []member
	for _, t := range toks {
		if t.kind != 'k' {
			continue
		}
		j := t.e
		for j < len(b) && b[j] != ':' {
			j++
		}
		j++
		for j < len(b) && (b[j] == ' ' || b[j] == '\n' || b[j] == '\t' || b[j] == '\r') {
			j++
		}
		out = append(out, member{t.s, t.e, j, valueEnd(b, j)})
	}
	return out
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the operators

var dupValues = []string{"5", "1.5", `"x"`, "true", "null", "{}", "[]", "-1", `"0"`}
var numForms = []string{"%s.0", "%se0", "%sE0", "%s.5", "-0", "18446744073709551616", "9007199254740993", "1e2", "0%s", "-%s", "%s000000000000000000000", "+%s"}

var hexRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^"[0-9a-fA-F]{2,}"$`)

type opFn func(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string)

func pick[T any](r *rand.Rand, xs []T) (T, bool) {
	var z T
	if len(xs) == 0 {
		return z, false
	}
	return xs[r.Intn(len(xs))], true
}

func ofKind(toks []tok, kind byte) []tok {
	var out []tok
	for _, t := range toks {
		if t.kind == kind {
			out = append(out, t)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func opNumber(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	t, ok := pick(r, ofKind(toks, 'n'))
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	form := numForms[r.Intn(len(numForms))]
	lit := string(b[t.s:t.e])
	nv := form
	if strings.Contains(form, "%s") {
		nv = fmt.Sprintf(form, lit)
	}
	return []ByteEdit{{t.s, t.e - t.s, ins(nv)}}, "num:" + form
}

func opNumString(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	t, ok := pick(r, ofKind(toks, 'n'))
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	return []ByteEdit{{t.s, t.e - t.s, ins(`"` + string(b[t.s:t.e]) + `"`)}}, "numstring"
}

func opDup(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	m, ok := pick(r, ms)
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	key := string(b[m.ks:m.ke])
	v := dupValues[r.Intn(len(dupValues))]
	if r.Intn(5) == 0 {
		v = string(b[m.vs:m.ve])
	}
	switch r.Intn(4) {
	case 0: // a wrongly typed or null value before
		return []ByteEdit{{m.ks, 0, ins(key + ":" + v + ",")}}, "dupbefore"
	case 1: // after
		return []ByteEdit{{m.ve, 0, ins("," + key + ":" + v)}}, "dupafter"
	case 2: // after, in another case
		return []ByteEdit{{m.ve, 0, ins("," + foldKey(r, key) + ":" + v)}}, "dupcase"
	default: // the whole member twice
		return []ByteEdit{{m.ve, 0, ins("," + key + ":" + string(b[m.vs:m.ve]))}}, "dupsame"
	}
}

// foldKey writes a key in another case or with a character of its Unicode fold set (U+017F for s, U+212A for k).
func foldKey(r *rand.Rand, key string) string {
	inner := key[1 : len(key)-1]
	switch r.Intn(5) {
	case 0:
		if strings.Contains(inner, "s") {
			return `"` + strings.Replace(inner, "s", "ſ", 1) + `"`
		}
	case 1:
		if strings.Contains(inner, "k") {
			return `"` + strings.Replace(inner, "k", "K", 1) + `"`
		}
	case 2:
		if strings.Contains(inner, "s") {
			return `"` + strings.Replace(inner, "s", `ſ`, 1) + `"`
		}
	case 3:
		return `"` + strings.ToUpper(inner) + `"`
	}
	if inner == "" {
		return key
	}
	return `"` + strings.ToUpper(inner[:1]) + inner[1:] + `"`
}

func opKeyFold(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	t, ok := pick(r, ofKind(toks, 'k'))
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	return []ByteEdit{{t.s, t.e - t.s, ins(foldKey(r, string(b[t.s:t.e])))}}, "keyfold"
}

func opHexString(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	var hs []tok
	for _, t := range toks {
		if t.kind == 'v' && hexRe.Match(b[t.s:t.e]) {
			hs = append(hs, t)
		}
	}
	t, ok := pick(r, hs)
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	inner := string(b[t.s+1 : t.e-1])
	var nv string
	switch r.Intn(6) {
	case 0:
		nv = inner + `\n`
	case 1:
		nv = inner + " "
	case 2:
		nv = "0x" + inner
	case 3:
		nv = strings.ToUpper(inner)
	case 4:
		nv = inner[:len(inner)-1]
	default:
		nv = inner + `\u0000`
	}
	return []ByteEdit{{t.s, t.e - t.s, ins(`"` + nv + `"`)}}, "hexstring"
}

func opUTF8(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	cands := append(ofKind(toks, 'v'), ofKind(toks, 'k')...)
	t, ok := pick(r, cands)
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	pool := []string{"\xe2\x82", "\xf0\x9f\x98", "\xff", "\xc0\x80", `\ud800`, `\udc00`, `\ud800A`, "\xed\xa0\x80", "\xef\xbf\xbd"}
	return []ByteEdit{{t.s + 1, 0, ins(pool[r.Intn(len(pool))])}}, "utf8"
}

func opWhitespace(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	t, ok := pick(r, toks)
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	ws := []string{" ", "\n", "\t", "\r\n", "  \n  "}
	return []ByteEdit{{t.s, 0, ins(ws[r.Intn(len(ws))])}}, "whitespace"
}

func opCount(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	var cs []member
	for _, m := range ms {
		if string(b[m.ks:m.ke]) == `"count"` {
			cs = append(cs, m)
		}
	}
	m, ok := pick(r, cs)
	if !ok {
		return nil, ""
	}
	v := []string{"0", "2", "3", "9", "18446744073709551615"}[r.Intn(5)]
	return []ByteEdit{{m.vs, m.ve - m.vs, ins(v)}}, "count"
}

func opGarbage(r *rand.Rand, b []byte, toks []tok, ms []member) ([]ByteEdit, string) {
	switch r.Intn(5) {
	case 0:
		return []ByteEdit{{len(b), 0, ins(" x")}}, "trailing"
	case 1:
		return []ByteEdit{{0, 0, ins("\xef\xbb\xbf")}}, "bom"
	case 2:
		return []ByteEdit{{len(b), 0, ins("\n")}}, "newline"
	case 3:
		return []ByteEdit{{len(b), 0, ins("{}")}}, "twodocs"
	default:
		return []ByteEdit{{len(b) / 2, len(b) - len(b)/2, ""}}, "truncate"
	}
}

var byteOps = []struct {
	w  int
	fn opFn
}{{22, opNumber}, {18, opDup}, {12, opKeyFold}, {10, opHexString}, {8, opUTF8}, {6, opNumString}, {8, opWhitespace}, {6, opCount}, {4, opGarbage}}

func chooseOp(r *rand.Rand) opFn {
	total := 0
	for _, o := range byteOps {
		total += o.w
	}
	n := r.Intn(total)
	for _, o := range byteOps {
		if n < o.w {
			return o.fn
		}
		n -= o.w
	}
	return byteOps[0].fn
}

func overlap(a, b ByteEdit) bool {
	return a.At < b.At+b.Del+1 && b.At < a.At+a.Del+1
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the repros: the cases that a parsed tree cannot express, each named

type repro struct {
	id, base string
	edit     func(b []byte) []ByteEdit
}

// after is the offset of the first match of pat at or after the first occurrence of anchor in b (anchor "" for the start).
func after(b []byte, anchor string, pat *regexp.Regexp) (int, int, bool) {
	from := 0
	if anchor != "" {
		i := bytes.Index(b, []byte(anchor))
		if i < 0 {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		from = i
	}
	loc := pat.FindIndex(b[from:])
	if loc == nil {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	return from + loc[0], from + loc[1], true
}

func tokenRepro(id, base, anchor, pat, repl string) repro {
	re := regexp.MustCompile(pat)
	return repro{id, base, func(b []byte) []ByteEdit {
		s, e, ok := after(b, anchor, re)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		return []ByteEdit{{s, e - s, ins(repl)}}
	}}
}

func insertAt(id, base, anchor string, off int, text string) repro {
	return repro{id, base, func(b []byte) []ByteEdit {
		i := bytes.Index(b, []byte(anchor))
		if i < 0 {
			return nil
		}
		return []ByteEdit{{i + off, 0, ins(text)}}
	}}
}

func repros() []repro {
	vmp := "xpartition2/valid-mixed-partition.json"
	var out []repro
	for _, f := range []struct{ n, lit string }{{"float", "65.0"}, {"exp", "6.5e1"}, {"exp0", "65e0"}, {"2^64", "18446744073709551616"}, {"2^53+1", "9007199254740993"}, {"neg", "-65"}, {"str", `"65"`}} {
		out = append(out, tokenRepro("block="+f.n, vmp, `"pages"`, `"block":65`, `"block":`+f.lit))
	}
	for _, f := range []string{"1.0", "1e0", "1E0", "01", "-0", `"1"`} {
		out = append(out, tokenRepro("majors="+f, vmp, `"evidence"`, `"majors":1`, `"majors":`+f))
		out = append(out, tokenRepro("anchor number="+f, vmp, `"acc://bvn-BVN3.acme"`, `"number":1`, `"number":`+f))
	}
	out = append(out,
		insertAt("version dup number first", vmp, `"version":"2.1"`, 0, `"version":5,`),
		insertAt("version dup null after", vmp, `"version":"2.1"`, len(`"version":"2.1"`), `,"version":null`),
		insertAt("version dup fold first", vmp, `"version":"2.1"`, 0, `"VERSION":{},`),
		insertAt("roles fold long s", vmp, `"pages":[{`, len(`"pages":[{`), `"roleſ":null,`),
		insertAt("roles fold long s escaped", vmp, `"pages":[{`, len(`"pages":[{`), `"roleſ":null,`),
		insertAt("roles upper dup null", vmp, `"pages":[{`, len(`"pages":[{`), `"ROLES":null,`),
		insertAt("partition kelvin-free upper", vmp, `"pages":[{`, len(`"pages":[{`), `"PARTITION":"bvn-BVN2.acme",`),
	)
	// the receipt hash and the set check's secondaryHash, given a later null
	out = append(out, repro{"hash dup null after", vmp, func(b []byte) []ByteEdit {
		o := bytes.Index(b, []byte(`"receipt"`))
		if o < 0 {
			return nil
		}
		loc := regexp.MustCompile(`"hash":"[0-9a-f]{64}"`).FindIndex(b[o:])
		if loc == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return []ByteEdit{{o + loc[1], 0, ins(`,"hash":null`)}}
	}})
	out = append(out, repro{"secondaryHash fold null after", vmp, func(b []byte) []ByteEdit {
		re := regexp.MustCompile(`"secondaryHash":"[0-9a-f]{64}"`)
		loc := re.FindIndex(b)
		if loc == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return []ByteEdit{{loc[1], 0, ins(`,"SecondaryHash":null`)}}
	}})
	// 2.0 documents carrying 2.1 members (the 2.0 verifier refuses them as Go does), in every case the document allows
	v20 := "proofv2/valid.json.gz"
	for _, k := range []struct{ id, anchor, text string }{
		{"20 Anchors", `"evidence":{`, `"Anchors":{"acc://bvn-BVN1.acme":{"message":{},"receipt":{}}},`},
		{"20 anchors empty", `"evidence":{`, `"anchors":{},`},
		{"20 anchors null", `"evidence":{`, `"anchors":null,`},
		{"20 VOTES", `"evidence":{`, `"VOTES":[{"authority":"a"}],`},
		{"20 votes empty", `"evidence":{`, `"votes":[],`},
		{"20 votes string", `"evidence":{`, `"votes":"x",`},
		{"20 anchors array", `"evidence":{`, `"anchors":[1],`},
		{"20 transaction number", `"evidence":{`, `"transaction":5,`},
		{"20 transaction string", `"evidence":{`, `"transaction":"00",`},
		{"20 Transaction string", `"evidence":{`, `"Transaction":"00",`},
		{"20 routing", `"check":{`, `"routing":{},`},
		{"20 Routing", `"check":{`, `"Routing":{"accountUrl":"acc://dn.acme/routing"},`},
		{"20 routing null", `"check":{`, `"routing":null,`},
		{"20 page Partition", `"pages":[{`, `"Partition":"bvn1",`},
		{"20 page partition number", `"pages":[{`, `"partition":5,`},
		{"20 page partition empty", `"pages":[{`, `"partition":"",`},
		{"20 page ROLES", `"pages":[{`, `"ROLES":["voter"],`},
		{"20 page roles empty", `"pages":[{`, `"roles":[],`},
		{"20 page roles null", `"pages":[{`, `"roles":null,`},
		{"20 page roles string", `"pages":[{`, `"roles":"voter",`},
		{"20 page history number", `"pages":[{`, `"history":7,`},
		{"20 page history", `"pages":[{`, `"history":{"entries":[],"index":[]},`},
		{"20 page History null", `"pages":[{`, `"History":null,`},
	} {
		k := k
		out = append(out, insertAt(k.id, v20, k.anchor, len(k.anchor), k.text))
	}
	// D4 and D5: the spine's records and the genesis
	tl := "xpartition2b/timeline-valid.json"
	out = append(out,
		tokenRepro("rootProof count 0", tl, `"rootProof"`, `"count":1`, `"count":0`),
		tokenRepro("rootProof count 2", tl, `"rootProof"`, `"count":1`, `"count":2`),
		tokenRepro("rootProof count float", tl, `"rootProof"`, `"count":1`, `"count":1.0`),
	)
	ra := "xpartition2/routing-absent.json"
	out = append(out,
		repro{"genesis publicKeyHash newline", ra, func(b []byte) []ByteEdit {
			re := regexp.MustCompile(`"publicKeyHash":"[0-9a-f]+"`)
			ls := re.FindAllIndex(b, -1)
			if len(ls) < 3 {
				return nil
			}
			return []ByteEdit{{ls[2][1] - 1, 0, ins(`\n`)}}
		}},
		repro{"genesis publicKeyHash object dup", ra, func(b []byte) []ByteEdit {
			re := regexp.MustCompile(`"publicKeyHash":"[0-9a-f]+"`)
			ls := re.FindAllIndex(b, -1)
			if len(ls) < 3 {
				return nil
			}
			return []ByteEdit{{ls[2][0], 0, ins(`"publicKeyHash":{},`)}}
		}},
		tokenRepro("genesis timeUnix string", ra, `"genesis"`, `"timeUnix":1700000000`, `"timeUnix":"1700000000"`),
		tokenRepro("genesis timeUnix float", ra, `"genesis"`, `"timeUnix":1700000000`, `"timeUnix":1700000000.0`),
		tokenRepro("genesis minorBlockIndex exp", ra, `"genesis"`, `"minorBlockIndex":1`, `"minorBlockIndex":1e0`),
		insertAt("genesis fold key dup", ra, `"genesis":{`, len(`"genesis":{`), `"TimeUnix":"x",`),
	)
	// invalid UTF-8 in a name a refusal prints
	out = append(out,
		insertAt("utf8 in a partition", vmp, `"partition":"`, len(`"partition":"`), "\xe2\x82"),
		insertAt("utf8 in a partition 4-byte", vmp, `"partition":"`, len(`"partition":"`), "\xf0\x9f\x98"),
		insertAt("surrogate in a partition", vmp, `"partition":"`, len(`"partition":"`), `\ud800`),
	)
	return out
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func bytesBases(fixtures string) ([]string, error) {
	var bases []string
	for _, suite := range []string{"xpartition", "xpartition2", "xpartition2b", "xpartition3", "xpartition3b", "xpartition4", "xpartition5"} {
		ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(fixtures, suite))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, e := range ents {
			n := e.Name()
			if e.IsDir() || n == "manifest.json" || n == "MANIFEST.sha256" || n == ".gitattributes" {
				continue
			}
			if strings.HasSuffix(n, ".json") || strings.HasSuffix(n, ".json.gz") {
				bases = append(bases, suite+"/"+n)
			}
		}
	}
	bases = append(bases, "proofv2/valid.json.gz", "proofv2/network-update.json.gz", "go-written/real-bvn1-billing-receipts.portable.json.gz")
	return bases, nil
}

func baseDoc(fixtures, base string) ([]byte, error) {
	if strings.HasPrefix(base, "proofv2/") {
		return readDoc(filepath.Join(fixtures, "..", base))
	}
	return readDoc(filepath.Join(fixtures, base))
}

func bytesCorpus(fixtures, out string, per int) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "Portable documents judged from their text by json.Unmarshal into Portable and VerifyPortable: byte edits of the shared vectors, both 2.0 fixtures and the real document - number literals, duplicate and fold-equivalent keys, hex with a newline, strings given for numbers, invalid UTF-8, whitespace - and named repros. A document on which Go panics or answers differently on repeated runs is not recorded."}
	bases, err := bytesBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStable(raw)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	record := func(id string, bi int, op string, edits []ByteEdit) {
		text := applyEdits(docs[bi], edits)
		lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
		e, ok := judgeStableCounting(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
		if !ok {
			if lastPanic != "" {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC %s [%s]: %s\n", id, op, lastPanic)
			} else {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "FLAKY %s [%s]: %s\n", id, op, lastFlaky)
			}
			return
		}
		f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: id, Base: bi, Op: op, Edits: edits, Expect: e})
	}
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		toks := scanTokens(docs[bi])
		ms := members(docs[bi], toks)
		n := per
		if strings.HasPrefix(bpath, "go-written/") {
			n = per * 2
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(bpath, "proofv2/") {
			n = per * 10 // the 2.0 fixtures are two documents: the share of the corpus that tests evidence 2.0 is made here
		}
		for k := 0; k < n; k++ {
			r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(seedOf("bytes", bpath, fmt.Sprint(k))))
			var edits []ByteEdit
			var names []string
			count := 1
			if r.Intn(4) == 0 {
				count = 2
			}
			for c := 0; c < count; c++ {
				es, name := chooseOp(r)(r, docs[bi], toks, ms)
				if es == nil {
					continue
				}
				clash := false
				for _, e := range edits {
					for _, x := range es {
						if overlap(e, x) {
							clash = true
						}
					}
				}
				if clash {
					continue
				}
				edits = append(edits, es...)
				names = append(names, name)
			}
			if len(edits) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			record(fmt.Sprintf("%s#%02d", bpath, k), bi, strings.Join(names, " + "), edits)
		}
	}
	for _, rp := range repros() {
		bi := -1
		for i, b := range bases {
			if b == rp.base {
				bi = i
			}
		}
		if bi < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("repro %s: base %s is not a base", rp.id, rp.base)
		}
		edits := rp.edit(docs[bi])
		if edits == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("repro %s: the pattern does not occur in %s", rp.id, rp.base)
		}
		record("repro:"+rp.id, bi, "repro", edits)
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, "bytes-cases.json.gz"), mustJSON(f))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the first sibling of every state receipt: AccountStateProof.verifyChainBinding compares the STRING strings.ToLower(Entries[0].Hash) with
// the 64-character secondaryHash, so a "0x" spelling (and a "0x" spelling of an upper-cased one) can never be the first sibling, while an
// upper-cased one is. The random operators reach entries[0].hash only by chance (hexstring hits any hex token), so this pass is systematic:
// for EVERY "stateReceipt" in EVERY base document (the set check's network and globals accounts of evidence 2.0 and 2.1, and the page
// receipts that carry one) it records three spellings of the receipt's first sibling, each judged by the validator. It is a separate
// command (firstsibling) writing its own file, so the earlier corpora stay as they were judged.

var firstSiblingRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"stateReceipt"\s*:\s*\{[^{}]*?"entries"\s*:\s*\[\s*\{\s*"hash"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F]{64})"`)

func firstSiblingCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "The first sibling (entries[0].hash) of every stateReceipt of every base document - the set check's network and globals accounts of evidence 2.0 and 2.1 and the page receipts - spelled with a 0x prefix, upper-cased, and both, judged by VerifyPortable from the text. Go compares the lower-cased STRING with the 64-character secondaryHash, so the 0x spellings are refused as 'secondaryHash is not the receipt's first sibling'."}
	bases, err := bytesBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStable(raw)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		for k, loc := range firstSiblingRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(docs[bi], -1) {
			s, e := loc[2], loc[3]
			h := string(docs[bi][s:e])
			for _, v := range []struct{ name, text string }{{"0x", "0x" + h}, {"upper", strings.ToUpper(h)}, {"0x upper", "0x" + strings.ToUpper(h)}} {
				edits := []ByteEdit{{s, e - s, ins(v.text)}}
				text := applyEdits(docs[bi], edits)
				lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
				ex, ok := judgeStableCounting(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
				if !ok {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s receipt %d [%s]\n", bpath, k, v.name)
					continue
				}
				f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("firstsibling:%s#%d:%s", bpath, k, v.name), Base: bi, Op: "firstsibling " + v.name, Edits: edits, Expect: ex})
			}
		}
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, "bytes-cases-firstsibling.json.gz"), mustJSON(f))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// every hex spelling the state-receipt check reads as a STRING or as bytes. validator_set_proof.go compares strings in several places
// (strings.ToLower(Entries[0].Hash) with the 64-character secondaryHash, hex(H(chains||pending)) with strings.ToLower(Entries[1].Hash),
// hex(sha256(state)) with MustHex32Lower(start), the recomputed root with MustHex32Lower(anchor), and the chain's restated anchor with
// ToLower(TrimPrefix(anchor, "0x")), which leaves a "0X" prefix in place) and decodes bytes in others (recomputeReceipt, which lower-cases
// before it trims "0x"; hexBytes, which trims space; the pending entries). A TypeScript port that compares decoded bytes where Go compares
// the string gives a verdict Go does not. This pass is systematic: for EVERY "stateReceipt" object of EVERY base document it spells start,
// anchor and entries[k].hash for EVERY k, and, for the AccountStateProof that carries them, secondaryHash, pendingHash, every chain
// pending[i] and every chain anchor, and records what the validator says. Separate command (receiptspell) and file; earlier corpora unchanged.

var receiptHexRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"(start|anchor|hash)"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F]{64})"`)
var stateReceiptKeyRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"stateReceipt"\s*:\s*\{`)
var accountHexRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"(secondaryHash|pendingHash)"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F]{64})"`)
var pendingListRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"pending"\s*:\s*\[([^\]\[]*)\]`)
var pendingEntryRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"([0-9a-fA-F]{64})"`)
var chainAnchorRe = regexp.MustCompile(`"pending"\s*:\s*\[[^\]\[]*\][^{}\[\]]*?"anchor"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F]{64})"`)

// objectEnd returns the index just past the JSON object that opens at doc[open] ('{'), or -1.
func objectEnd(doc []byte, open int) int {
	depth, inStr := 0, false
	for i := open; i < len(doc); i++ {
		c := doc[i]
		if inStr {
			if c == 0x5c {
				i++
			} else if c == '"' {
				inStr = false
			}
			continue
		}
		switch c {
		case '"':
			inStr = true
		case '{':
			depth++
		case '}':
			depth--
			if depth == 0 {
				return i + 1
			}
		}
	}
	return -1
}

type spellSite struct {
	name       string
	start, end int
	wide       bool // also spell with space padding and a "0X" prefix
}

func receiptSpellSites(doc []byte) []spellSite {
	var sites []spellSite
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	add := func(name string, s, e int, wide bool) {
		if seen[s] {
			return
		}
		seen[s] = true
		sites = append(sites, spellSite{name, s, e, wide})
	}
	for ri, loc := range stateReceiptKeyRe.FindAllIndex(doc, -1) {
		open := loc[1] - 1
		end := objectEnd(doc, open)
		if end < 0 {
			continue
		}
		k := 0
		for _, m := range receiptHexRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(doc[open:end], -1) {
			key := string(doc[open+m[2] : open+m[3]])
			name := fmt.Sprintf("receipt%d.%s", ri, key)
			if key == "hash" {
				name = fmt.Sprintf("receipt%d.entries[%d]", ri, k)
				k++
			}
			add(name, open+m[4], open+m[5], false)
		}
	}
	for _, m := range accountHexRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(doc, -1) {
		add(string(doc[m[2]:m[3]]), m[4], m[5], true)
	}
	for li, m := range pendingListRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(doc, -1) {
		for pi, p := range pendingEntryRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(doc[m[2]:m[3]], -1) {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("chain%d.pending[%d]", li, pi), m[2]+p[2], m[2]+p[3], true)
		}
	}
	for ci, m := range chainAnchorRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(doc, -1) {
		add(fmt.Sprintf("chain%d.anchor", ci), m[2], m[3], true)
	}
	sort.Slice(sites, func(i, j int) bool { return sites[i].start < sites[j].start })
	return sites
}

func receiptSpellCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "Every 64-hex spelling the state-receipt check reads: start, anchor and entries[k].hash of every stateReceipt for every k, and secondaryHash, pendingHash, every chain pending[i] and every chain anchor, each spelled with a 0x prefix, upper-cased, both (and, for the account fields, with a 0X prefix and padded with spaces), judged by VerifyPortable from the text."}
	bases, err := bytesBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStable(raw)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	// XTS_SHARD=i/n judges only every n-th (site, spelling) from the i-th, into bytes-cases-receiptspell-<i>.json.gz, so the cases can be judged by
	// n processes at once; the shards are merged, ordered by id, into bytes-cases-receiptspell.json.gz (the Skipped counts added).
	shard, shards := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(v, "%d/%d", &shard, &shards); err != nil || shards < 1 || shard < 0 || shard >= shards {
			return fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
	}
	n, seq := 0, 0
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		for _, site := range receiptSpellSites(docs[bi]) {
			h := string(docs[bi][site.start:site.end])
			spells := []struct{ name, text string }{{"0x", "0x" + h}, {"upper", strings.ToUpper(h)}, {"0x upper", "0x" + strings.ToUpper(h)}, {"0X", "0X" + h}}
			if site.wide {
				spells = append(spells, struct{ name, text string }{"space", " " + h + " "})
			}
			for _, v := range spells {
				if seq++; (seq-1)%shards != shard {
					continue
				}
				edits := []ByteEdit{{site.start, site.end - site.start, ins(v.text)}}
				text := applyEdits(docs[bi], edits)
				lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
				ex, ok := judgeStableCounting(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
				if !ok {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s %s [%s]\n", bpath, site.name, v.name)
					continue
				}
				f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("receiptspell:%s:%s:%s", bpath, site.name, v.name), Base: bi, Op: "receiptspell " + v.name, Edits: edits, Expect: ex})
				if n++; n%2000 == 0 {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "receiptspell: %d cases judged\n", n)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	name := "bytes-cases-receiptspell.json.gz"
	if shards > 1 {
		name = fmt.Sprintf("bytes-cases-receiptspell-%d.json.gz", shard)
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, name), mustJSON(f))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// every string member of every document, by PATH CLASS. The receipt and first-sibling passes above spell the members of the state-receipt
// check one site at a time; a port that reads another member with a lenient reader (a hex decoder that strips "0x" or trims, a partition
// normaliser that uses JS trim) is not reached by them. This pass closes the whole class: for EVERY base document it walks the JSON text,
// takes every string member whose value is hex (even length >= 2) or a partition / URL / account name, collapses array indices to [*] and
// URL-shaped object keys to {url} (the path class, e.g. evidence.pages[*].receipt.entries[*].hash), keeps the FIRST occurrence of each class
// and spells it
//   hex:   "0x"+v, "0X"+v, UPPER, ASCII-space-padded
//   name:  UPPER, ASCII-space-padded, U+FEFF prefix, U+0085 prefix, U+00A0 prefix, tab/newline pad (written as \t and \n escapes, so the
//          JSON stays well formed; Go's strings.TrimSpace removes U+0085, U+00A0, tab and newline but NOT U+FEFF)
// Classes whose first occurrence is a site of the receiptspell pass (and so of the firstsibling pass) are skipped: already judged there.
// Separate command (pathspell) and file; XTS_SHARD=i/n shards the (class, spelling) sequence exactly like receiptspell.

type pathMember struct {
	class  string
	key    string
	vs, ve int // the string's content, quotes excluded
	val    string
}

type pathWalker struct {
	b   []byte
	out []pathMember
}

func (w *pathWalker) ws(i int) int {
	for i < len(w.b) && (w.b[i] == ' ' || w.b[i] == '\n' || w.b[i] == '\t' || w.b[i] == '\r') {
		i++
	}
	return i
}

// str returns the end (past the closing quote) of the string that opens at i.
func (w *pathWalker) str(i int) int {
	j := i + 1
	for j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] != '"' {
		if w.b[j] == '\\' {
			j++
		}
		j++
	}
	return j + 1
}

func (w *pathWalker) value(i int, class, key string) int {
	i = w.ws(i)
	if i >= len(w.b) {
		return i
	}
	switch w.b[i] {
	case '"':
		e := w.str(i)
		raw := w.b[i+1 : e-1]
		if !bytes.Contains(raw, []byte{'\\'}) {
			w.out = append(w.out, pathMember{class, key, i + 1, e - 1, string(raw)})
		}
		return e
	case '{':
		i = w.ws(i + 1)
		for i < len(w.b) && w.b[i] != '}' {
			ke := w.str(i)
			k := string(w.b[i+1 : ke-1])
			name := k
			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(k), "acc://") {
				name = "{url}"
			}
			c := name
			if class != "" {
				c = class + "." + name
			}
			i = w.ws(ke)
			i++ // ':'
			i = w.value(i, c, name)
			i = w.ws(i)
			if i < len(w.b) && w.b[i] == ',' {
				i = w.ws(i + 1)
			}
		}
		return i + 1
	case '[':
		i = w.ws(i + 1)
		for i < len(w.b) && w.b[i] != ']' {
			i = w.value(i, class+"[*]", key)
			i = w.ws(i)
			if i < len(w.b) && w.b[i] == ',' {
				i = w.ws(i + 1)
			}
		}
		return i + 1
	default:
		j := i
		for j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] != ',' && w.b[j] != '}' && w.b[j] != ']' && w.b[j] != ' ' && w.b[j] != '\n' && w.b[j] != '\t' && w.b[j] != '\r' {
			j++
		}
		return j
	}
}

var pathHexRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-fA-F]{2,}$`)
var pathNameKeyRe = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)partition|url|principal|origin|signer|account|network|ledger|source|destination|authority|delegate|keybook|^page$|cause|txid`)

func pathKind(m pathMember) string {
	if len(m.val)%2 == 0 && pathHexRe.MatchString(m.val) {
		return "hex"
	}
	if m.val != "" && (strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(m.val), "acc://") || pathNameKeyRe.MatchString(m.key)) {
		return "name"
	}
	return ""
}

type pathRep struct {
	class, kind string
	vs, ve      int
}

// pathReps are the first occurrences, in document order, of every path class that is hex or a name and not a receiptspell site.
func pathReps(doc []byte) (reps []pathRep, covered int) {
	w := &pathWalker{b: doc}
	w.value(0, "", "")
	spell := map[int]bool{}
	for _, s := range receiptSpellSites(doc) {
		spell[s.start] = true
	}
	for _, loc := range firstSiblingRe.FindAllSubmatchIndex(doc, -1) {
		spell[loc[2]] = true
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range w.out {
		k := pathKind(m)
		if k == "" || seen[m.class] {
			continue
		}
		seen[m.class] = true
		if spell[m.vs] {
			covered++
			continue
		}
		reps = append(reps, pathRep{m.class, k, m.vs, m.ve})
	}
	return reps, covered
}

type pathSpelling struct{ name, text string }

func pathSpellings(kind, v string) []pathSpelling {
	var all []pathSpelling
	if kind == "hex" {
		all = []pathSpelling{{"0x", "0x" + v}, {"0X", "0X" + v}, {"upper", strings.ToUpper(v)}, {"space", " " + v + " "}}
	} else {
		all = []pathSpelling{{"upper", strings.ToUpper(v)}, {"space", " " + v + " "}, {"feff", string(rune(0xFEFF)) + v}, {"nel", string(rune(0x85)) + v}, {"nbsp", string(rune(0xA0)) + v}, {"tabnl", `\t` + v + `\n`}}
	}
	var out []pathSpelling
	for _, s := range all {
		if s.text != v {
			out = append(out, s)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func pathSpellCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "The first occurrence of every path class of every string member that is hex (even length >= 2) or a partition / URL / account name, in every base document, spelled - hex: 0x, 0X, upper-cased, space-padded; name: upper-cased, space-padded, U+FEFF / U+0085 / U+00A0 prefixed, tab-and-newline padded - judged by VerifyPortable from the text. Classes already spelled by the receiptspell and firstsibling corpora are not repeated."}
	bases, err := bytesBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStable(raw)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	shard, shards := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(v, "%d/%d", &shard, &shards); err != nil || shards < 1 || shard < 0 || shard >= shards {
			return fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
	}
	n, seq, skipped := 0, 0, 0
	classes := map[string]bool{}
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		reps, covered := pathReps(docs[bi])
		skipped += covered
		for _, rp := range reps {
			classes[rp.class] = true
			h := string(docs[bi][rp.vs:rp.ve])
			for _, v := range pathSpellings(rp.kind, h) {
				if seq++; (seq-1)%shards != shard {
					continue
				}
				edits := []ByteEdit{{rp.vs, rp.ve - rp.vs, ins(v.text)}}
				text := applyEdits(docs[bi], edits)
				lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
				ex, ok := judgeStableCounting(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
				if !ok {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s %s [%s]\n", bpath, rp.class, v.name)
					continue
				}
				f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("pathspell:%s:%s:%s", bpath, rp.class, v.name), Base: bi, Op: "pathspell " + rp.kind + " " + v.name, Edits: edits, Expect: ex})
				if n++; n%2000 == 0 {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "pathspell: %d cases judged\n", n)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "pathspell shard %d/%d: %d path classes, %d (class,base) pairs already covered by receiptspell, %d spellings in all, %d judged here\n", shard, shards, len(classes), skipped, seq, len(f.Cases))
	name := "bytes-cases-pathspell.json.gz"
	if shards > 1 {
		name = fmt.Sprintf("bytes-cases-pathspell-%d.json.gz", shard)
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, name), mustJSON(f))
}
